Meta.title: Indah Morib Homestay: Your Home Away From Home
Meta.description: Homestay compound in Morib, Selangor, for family retreats, gatherings, and celebrations. Private pools and up to 120 guests.
Meta.keywords: homestay Morib, homestay Selangor, family homestay Malaysia, private pool homestay, Banting homestay

Hero.lede: A compound near Morib Beach for family retreats, gatherings, and celebrations. An hour from Kuala Lumpur, a world away from the everyday.
Hero.photoAlt: The pool area at Indah Morib Homestay, Selangor

About.p1: Nestled in the heart of Malaysia, Indah Morib Homestay offers a blend of modern comfort and warm hospitality. Each room is designed around how families actually use a home together.
About.p2: Whether you're here for a family getaway, a celebration, or a company retreat, our team handles the details so the day runs itself.

checkin.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
checkin.a: Check-in is from {checkIn} and check-out is before {checkOut}.

pool.a: Yes. Homestay 3 has a covered, Muslimah-friendly pool and a children's pool. Homestay 2 also has its own pool.

guests.a: Each unit sleeps 3 to 10 people. Large groups can book several units together. Our hall holds 100 guests for events.

hall.q: How much does the event hall cost?
hall.a: Weekdays: RM800 (8 a.m. - 6 p.m.), RM900 (8 a.m. - 10 p.m.) or RM1,000 overnight. Weekends: RM900, RM1,000 or RM1,200.

book.a: Choose a unit on this site, pick your dates and pay online. You can also WhatsApp us at {phone}.
